blocking_reasons: BLOCKING (win-bundle and win-host-tools found it separately; all 4 adversarial votes kept it BLOCKING): the lifecycle workflow at S looks for the bundle at a path this artifact does not have. At S, .github/workflows/windows11-native-lifecycle.yml:135 downloads the candidate into $RUNNER_TEMP/japp-reviewed-win11-inputs, and line 144 passes --bundle "$RUNNER_TEMP/japp-reviewed-win11-inputs/inputs". The prepare workflow at S uploads two paths, japp-unreviewed-win11-candidate/retained/ and retention-failure.json. Because of that, upload-artifact used their common parent as the root, and every one of the 1530 members of artifact 13023973641 sits under retained/. After download the bundle is at .../retained/inputs, so audit_bundle() fails with FileNotFoundError before any tool install or VM step. It fails closed and nothing is exposed, but a campaign released on this candidate can never pass. The lifecycle and prepare workflows are PROTECTED and must match S byte for byte, so the fix needs a new S, a new package build and a new candidate. I confirmed this myself: line 144 at S, the two-path upload at S, and the unzipped candidate has only a retained/ top folder.
